name: io.github.VAAS-X/flowgate
title: FlowGate Launch Verdict
description: New Uniswap v4 pool checks on Base: free preview and x402 pay-per-call verdicts. Facts, not advice.

tools.name: recent_launches
tools.description: Free. Lists the newest ETH/WETH-quoted Uniswap v4 pools on Base from FlowGate's launch index: token, pool id, age in minutes, hook class and swaps so far.

tools.name: launch_preview
tools.description: Free, rate limited. For a pool in the launch index: a label from pool events only (swaps, liquidity changes, price moves) and counts of high, medium and info flags. No flag text, token-contract checks or precedent; the paid verdict has those. On-chain facts only: not a safety check, audit or forecast.

token_or_pool_id.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or Uniswap v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex), as listed by recent_launches.

tools.name: how_to_buy_verdict
tools.description: Free. Returns the URL, price ($0.01) and x402 payment details for the full Launch Verdict of a token or pool, and whether it is in the index. It does not pay or take any key; the caller pays with its own x402 client.

token_or_pool_id.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or Uniswap v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex), as listed by recent_launches.
